title: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16246v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models drive the robot directly from camera views, yet a VLA alone shows three typical failures. It walks past the goal, stops before reaching it, and rarely recovers after going off track. Pairing a VLA with a large language model (LLM) planner fixes these failures, but queries the LLM throughout every episode, adding token costs and latency. We introduce Harness-to-Executor (H2E), a session-level distillation method that pairs an LLM planner and a frozen VLA as a heterogeneous training agent, keeps only sessions that reach the goal, and then trains a VLA alone on them so no LLM is used at test time. In these sessions, the planner gives sub-instructions and moves the robot with its own tools, detours are common, and the planner decides when to stop. translated_title: VLA 能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接根据相机视角驱动机器人，但单独使用 VLA 会表现出三种典型失败：走过目标点、在到达目标前提前停下，以及偏离轨迹后难以恢复。将 VLA 与大型语言模型（LLM）规划器配对可以修复这些失败，但在每个回合中都需要持续查询 LLM，从而增加了 token 成本和延迟。我们提出 Harness-to-Executor（H2E），一种会话级蒸馏方法，它将 LLM 规划器与冻结的 VLA 组合为异构训练智能体，仅保留成功到达目标的会话，然后仅在这些会话上单独训练 VLA，因此在测试时无需使用 LLM。在这些会话中，规划器给出子指令并用其自身的工具移动机器人，绕路是常见现象，且由规划器决定何时停止。因此，无论移动由谁执行，H2E 都将每一次移动标注为原始任务的 VLA 动作。该方法对远离目标的步骤进行损失屏蔽，并为……（摘要截断）
tldr: H2E 提出会话级蒸馏方法，将 LLM 规划器与冻结 VLA 作为异构训练智能体，仅保留成功到达目标的会话并屏蔽偏离目标的步骤来训练 VLA，使其在测试时无需 LLM 即可克服走过目标、提前停止和偏离后难以恢复三种典型失败。
en_tdlr: H2E is a session-level distillation method that pairs an LLM planner with a frozen VLA as a heterogeneous training agent, keeps only successful goal-reaching sessions, and trains the VLA alone so it can overcome typical failures—overshooting, premature stopping, and poor recovery—without needing the LLM at test time.
